packs.title: Detective Duck: Tiny Mysteries with Clues
packs.subject: Funny Mysteries
packs.description: 20 playful mini-detective mysteries where all clues are given and there is only one correct deduction.

questions.question: Three pets are a cat, a dog and a rabbit. The rabbit is in the blue room, the dog is in the green room. Who is in the red room?
questions.explanation: With each pet assigned a different room, the remaining cat is in red.

questions.question: Mira, Leo and Nia own red, green and blue umbrellas. Mira has red, Leo does not have blue. Which colour does Nia have?
questions.explanation: Leo must have green; Nia gets blue.

questions.question: A thief left muddy footprints, but the floor had been dry and locked all day before a rainstorm. Which event most likely happened after rain began?
options: The rain fell indoors without an opening
Someone walked inside with wet shoes
questions.explanation: Wet muddy prints suggest someone entered after becoming muddy outside.

questions.question: Only one of three boxes contains a coin. Box A is empty and box C is empty. Where is the coin?
questions.explanation: Only B remains as the possible location.

questions.question: A note says "the secret is the first letter of CAT". Which letter is the secret?
questions.explanation: The first letter of CAT is C.

questions.question: A detective's watch stopped at 14:10. It has not moved since. What does its display show at 18:00?
questions.explanation: A stopped watch does not change its display.

questions.question: A robot leaves a room at 09:15 and returns 20 minutes later. When does it return?
questions.explanation: 15 minutes past 9 plus 20 minutes is 35 minutes past 9.

questions.question: The suspect's gloves are dry, but a wet glove is found outside. Can you identify the suspect from this fact alone?
options: Yes; definitely the person with a blue shirt
questions.explanation: A single glove observation cannot identify its owner conclusively.

questions.question: Three suspects have badges 11, 12 and 13. The clue says the badge number is even. Which badge matches?
questions.explanation: Only 12 is divisible by two.

questions.question: A museum has four doors. Only the north door was opened in the event log. Which door should investigators examine first for recorded entry?
questions.explanation: The entry log points to the north door; other evidence may still matter.

questions.question: A parrot repeats exactly the last word it hears. You say "yellow banana". What does it repeat?
questions.explanation: By the given rule it repeats only the final word.

questions.question: The code is the number of letters in MOON plus the number in STAR. What is the code?
questions.explanation: MOON has four letters and STAR has four, giving eight.

questions.question: All five biscuits are in a locked tin. Someone takes out two and does not replace them. How many remain in the tin?
questions.explanation: Five minus two leaves three.

questions.question: A detective needs to visit rooms A, B and C once each. She has visited A and B. Which room remains?
questions.explanation: Only room C is unvisited.

questions.question: A password clue says "a 3-digit code starting 42 and ending 7". What code fits?
questions.explanation: The first two digits are 42 and the last is 7.

questions.question: A message was sent at 11:00 and received at 11:02. Assuming clocks are synchronised, how long did delivery take?
questions.explanation: 11:02 minus 11:00 is two minutes.

questions.question: If only red cards trigger the alarm, and a blue card was scanned, should the alarm trigger under this rule?
questions.explanation: The stated rule triggers on red cards only.

questions.question: A detective compares two identical-sized bottles: one is full and one is half-full. Which contains more liquid?
questions.explanation: Equal capacity with one full means the full one holds more.

questions.question: The laboratory door opens only if both lights are green. One light is green, the other red. What happens?
questions.explanation: Both-green condition is not met.

questions.question: A security camera recorded three visitors entering and two exiting, with no other entrances or exits. How many of those visitors remain inside?
questions.explanation: Three entered and two left, leaving one of the recorded visitors.

packs.title: Everyday Things That Are Surprisingly Weird
packs.subject: Weird Everyday Science
packs.description: 20 quirky household phenomena with solid explanations: static hair, soap bubbles, popcorn and more.

questions.question: Why does popcorn suddenly pop when heated?
options: Salt makes it explode by itself
Water inside the kernel becomes pressurised steam
questions.explanation: Steam pressure builds until the kernel ruptures.

questions.question: Why can a rubbed balloon stick to a wall?
questions.explanation: Transferred electric charge can produce attraction.

questions.question: Why do soap bubbles often look rainbow-coloured?
options: Soap is naturally made of tiny rainbows
Thin-film interference separates reflected light colours
questions.explanation: Light reflecting from a thin film interferes at different wavelengths.

questions.question: Why can wet fingers make a glass surface seem slippery?
options: A water film changes friction at the contact surface
questions.explanation: Lubrication alters friction between surfaces.

questions.question: Why do onions sometimes make eyes water when cut?
questions.explanation: Cutting onions releases compounds that irritate the eyes.

questions.question: Why can a metal spoon feel colder than a wooden one in the same room?
options: Metal transfers heat away from skin more quickly
questions.explanation: Thermal conductivity affects how rapidly skin loses heat.

questions.question: Why does a straw make liquid rise when you sip?
options: The glass pushes liquid using electricity
Lower pressure inside the straw lets surrounding pressure push liquid up
questions.explanation: Pressure differences drive the liquid upward.

questions.question: Why does a fan often make sweaty skin feel cooler?
options: It increases evaporation and heat transfer
questions.explanation: Moving air speeds evaporation and convection.

questions.question: Why can you see your breath on a chilly morning?
options: Moist breath forms tiny liquid droplets in cool air
questions.explanation: Cooling water vapour can form a visible mist.

questions.question: Why does an unopened cold soda sometimes fizz when opened?
options: Dissolved carbon dioxide escapes as pressure falls
questions.explanation: Lower pressure allows dissolved gas to form bubbles.

questions.question: Why can ice make a drink float with cubes on top?
options: Ice is made of air only
Ice is less dense than liquid water
The glass pushes it upward magnetically
questions.explanation: A lower-density solid floats in a denser liquid.

questions.question: Why does cut apple flesh often brown after exposure to air?
options: The apple absorbs sunlight as paint
questions.explanation: Polyphenol oxidase contributes to browning reactions.

questions.question: Why do shadows grow longer when a low Sun shines near the horizon?
options: The light arrives at a shallow angle
questions.explanation: Low-angle sunlight stretches the shadow.

questions.question: Why can a lid on a jar be easier to open after warming it slightly?
options: Heating may expand the lid enough to loosen it
questions.explanation: Different thermal expansion can help loosen the fit.

questions.question: Why does water form rounded drops on some waxy leaves?
options: Surface tension and poor wetting of the leaf surface
questions.explanation: Cohesive forces and surface chemistry shape droplets.

questions.question: Why can sugar seem to disappear when stirred into water?
options: It dissolves and disperses among water molecules
questions.explanation: Dissolved sugar remains in the solution.

questions.question: What makes a rubber ball bounce?
options: Air always pushes it upward forever
It has a hidden motor in every case
Elastic deformation stores and returns some energy
questions.explanation: Material elasticity returns some stored energy after impact.

questions.question: Why do mirrors show a reversed-looking image without producing a second person?
options: They project your body behind the wall
They redirect incoming light into a virtual image
questions.explanation: Mirror reflections create virtual images from redirected light.

questions.question: Why is a rainbow often seen with the Sun behind the observer?
options: Rainwater contains coloured dust by default
Water droplets bend, reflect and disperse sunlight toward the viewer
The Sun becomes a laser screen
questions.explanation: The viewing geometry of sunlight and droplets creates a rainbow.

questions.question: Why does bread dough with yeast often rise?
options: Yeast produces carbon dioxide that forms bubbles in dough
questions.explanation: Fermentation can release gas trapped by the dough's structure.

packs.title: Teka-Teki Pelik Tapi Logik
packs.subject: Teka-Teki Pelik
packs.description: 20 teka-teki lucu dengan satu jawapan yang jelas dan penerangan Bahasa Melayu.

questions.question: Dalam setahun ada 12 bulan. Berapa bulan mempunyai sekurang-kurangnya 28 hari?
questions.explanation: Semua bulan mempunyai sekurang-kurangnya 28 hari.

questions.question: Ada 5 biji epal di meja. Kamu ambil 3. Berapa biji epal yang ada di tangan kamu?
questions.explanation: Soalan bertanya epal yang diambil, bukan yang masih di atas meja.

questions.question: Yang manakah lebih berat, 1 kg kapas atau 1 kg besi?
questions.explanation: Kedua-duanya berjisim satu kilogram.

questions.question: Seekor robot mempunyai 4 roda. Tiga robot sama mempunyai berapa roda?
questions.explanation: 3 darab 4 bersamaan 12 roda.

questions.question: Kamu memotong sebiji piza kepada 4 bahagian sama besar. Berapa bahagian semuanya?
questions.explanation: Bilangan kepingan yang dinyatakan ialah empat.

questions.question: Terdapat 10 ekor ikan di dalam akuarium. Dua mati tetapi tidak dikeluarkan. Berapa ekor masih di dalam akuarium?
questions.explanation: Ikan mati tetap berada dalam akuarium jika tidak dikeluarkan.

questions.question: Jam digital menunjukkan 10:00. Selepas 45 minit, apakah waktunya?
questions.explanation: 45 minit selepas pukul sepuluh ialah 10:45.

questions.question: Tiga raksasa masing-masing mempunyai dua mata. Jumlah semua mata mereka?
questions.explanation: 3 raksasa darab 2 mata bersamaan 6.

questions.question: Jika hari ini hari Isnin, tiga hari kemudian hari apa?
questions.explanation: Selasa hari pertama, Rabu kedua, Khamis ketiga.

questions.question: Ada 6 pensel. Dua diberi kepada kawan dan satu hilang. Berapa pensel tinggal?
questions.explanation: 6 tolak 2 tolak 1 bersamaan 3.

questions.question: Sebuah UFO membawa 7 makhluk asing. Dua turun dan tiga naik. Berapa penumpang sekarang?
Ada 4 pasang kasut. Berapa kasut individu semuanya?
questions.explanation: Setiap pasang mempunyai dua kasut.

questions.question: Sebuah buku mempunyai 20 halaman. Kamu baca 5 halaman. Berapa halaman belum dibaca?
questions.explanation: 20 tolak 5 sama dengan 15.

questions.question: Dua ekor kucing masing-masing makan 3 biskut. Berapa biskut dimakan?
questions.explanation: 2 darab 3 bersamaan 6.

questions.question: Kereta elektrik tanpa enjin pembakaran bergerak. Adakah ia mengeluarkan asap ekzos pembakaran seperti kereta petrol?
questions.explanation: Kereta elektrik tanpa sumber pembakaran tidak menghasilkan asap ekzos enjin petrol.

questions.question: Kamu berada di tempat kedua dalam perlumbaan dan memintas peserta pertama. Kamu kini nombor berapa?
questions.explanation: Memintas orang pertama menjadikan kamu peserta pertama.

questions.question: Sebiji tembikai dibahagi kepada 8 potongan sama besar. Empat potongan dimakan. Berapa potongan tinggal?
Lampu berkelip sekali setiap 2 saat. Dalam 10 saat, jika ia berkelip pada saat 2,4,6,8,10, berapa kali?
questions.explanation: Lima waktu yang disenaraikan menghasilkan lima kelipan.

questions.question: Ada 9 kerusi. Tujuh kerusi diduduki satu orang setiap satu. Berapa kerusi kosong?
questions.explanation: 9−7=2 kerusi kosong.

questions.question: Mesin menghasilkan 5 pelekat setiap minit. Berapa pelekat dalam 4 minit?
questions.explanation: 5 pelekat seminit darab 4 minit bersamaan 20.

packs.title: Sains Pelik: Betul atau Mengarut?
packs.subject: Sains Pelik
packs.description: 20 soalan sains yang pelik tetapi berdasarkan fenomena sebenar dan logik eksperimen.

questions.question: Mengapakah sudu logam terasa lebih sejuk daripada sudu kayu pada suhu bilik yang sama?
options: Logam memindahkan haba daripada tangan lebih cepat
questions.explanation: Kekonduksian haba logam lebih tinggi.

questions.question: Mengapa ais biasanya terapung di dalam air?
options: Ais kurang tumpat daripada air cecair
questions.explanation: Ketumpatan ais lebih rendah berbanding air cecair.

questions.question: Dalam ruang vakum, bolehkah bunyi loceng bergerak terus melalui ruang kosong?
questions.explanation: Gelombang bunyi biasa memerlukan medium untuk merambat.

questions.question: Mengapa pensel dalam gelas air kelihatan bengkok?
questions.explanation: Cahaya berubah arah apabila merentasi air dan udara.

questions.question: Apakah yang menyebabkan pelangi terbentuk?
options: Cahaya matahari dibiaskan, dipantulkan dan diuraikan oleh titisan air
questions.explanation: Cahaya berinteraksi dengan titisan air untuk menghasilkan spektrum.

questions.question: Mengapakah belon yang digosok boleh melekat pada dinding?
questions.explanation: Cas elektrik boleh menghasilkan daya tarikan.

questions.question: Mengapa bayang-bayang menjadi panjang apabila matahari rendah?
questions.explanation: Sudut cahaya mempengaruhi panjang bayang.

questions.question: Tumbuhan hijau memerlukan gas manakah untuk fotosintesis?
questions.explanation: Tumbuhan mengambil karbon dioksida untuk menghasilkan gula.

questions.question: Apakah fungsi utama akar tumbuhan?
options: Menyerap air dan mineral serta membantu menyokong tumbuhan
questions.explanation: Akar menyerap bahan dari tanah dan memberi sokongan.

questions.question: Mengapakah kita dapat melihat Bulan bersinar?
questions.explanation: Cahaya Bulan yang kelihatan kebanyakannya ialah pantulan cahaya matahari.

questions.question: Planet manakah mengambil masa putaran paksi lebih lama daripada tempoh orbitnya mengelilingi Matahari?
questions.explanation: Zuhrah berputar dalam kira-kira 243 hari Bumi dan mengorbit dalam kira-kira 225 hari.

questions.question: Planet manakah kelihatan berputar mengiring kerana kecondongan paksinya yang sangat besar?
questions.explanation: Paksi Uranus condong hampir 90 darjah.

questions.question: Sotong kurita biasanya mempunyai berapa jantung?
questions.explanation: Dua jantung mengepam darah ke insang dan satu ke seluruh badan.

questions.question: Mengapa darah sotong kurita boleh kelihatan biru?
questions.explanation: Hemocyanin menggunakan kuprum untuk membawa oksigen.

questions.question: Mengapakah air mendidih pada suhu lebih rendah di gunung tinggi?
questions.explanation: Tekanan rendah menurunkan suhu didih air.

questions.question: Mengapa udara bergerak daripada kipas sering menyejukkan kulit berpeluh?
options: Ia mempercepat penyejatan dan pemindahan haba
Ia membuat ketulan ais dalam udara
questions.explanation: Pengaliran udara meningkatkan penyejatan peluh.

questions.question: Apakah yang menyebabkan jagung bertih meletup ketika dipanaskan?
options: Tekanan wap air meningkat di dalam biji jagung
questions.explanation: Wap air yang terperangkap meningkatkan tekanan sehingga kulit pecah.

questions.question: Mengapa air gula boleh menjadi jernih selepas dikacau?
options: Gula larut dan tersebar di dalam air
questions.explanation: Molekul gula masih berada dalam larutan.

questions.question: Mengapakah kita dapat melihat wap seperti kabus daripada nafas pada pagi sejuk?
options: Wap air dalam nafas terkondensasi menjadi titisan kecil
questions.explanation: Udara sejuk membolehkan titisan kecil terbentuk.

questions.question: Apakah yang berlaku kepada jisim 2 kg kapas apabila dibandingkan dengan 2 kg batu menggunakan neraca tepat?
questions.explanation: Kedua-duanya ialah dua kilogram walaupun isipadunya berbeza.
